semantics: Retain branch decisions and TargetProof results; never infer validity from missing truncated diagnostics.
Invalidate all duplicate resolved source/client entries; authored state remains independent from valid and complete.
Complete requires a valid completed state and actual contextual target proof/current required approval, or valid approved retirement.
Use complete parity outcomes/dimensions/findings from the same validator operation; no separate assessment or recursion.
CoveragePopulation defines source-selection availability. Unavailable counts are null; confirmed-empty counts are zero and percentage is null.
Count source-feature identity, feature/client obligation, authored row and dimension obligation as distinct named units.
Absent undeclared optional dimensions are not-required, never passed. Present false claims remain invalid.
Current proposed/blocked decisions remain unresolved; historical rejected/superseded proposals are not active requirements.
Report output uses a fixed parity heading; coverage heading and bytes remain unchanged.
Explicit v1 family retains rows/feature_id/parity_status/verification; unversioned entries/id is compatibility-only; explicit v2 rejects in legacy helpers.
Invalid core parity reports retain a fail/unavailable diagnostic envelope; invalid-core publication still fails.
